name: P31 Loom
description: The design system as a live graph. Human and agent, co-present.

actions.name: loom.traverse
actions.description: Agent-side verb, not a UI affordance. The agent moves from one graph node to another. Never appears as a data-agent-action in the DOM; the agent commits it directly to the log.

actions.name: loom.propose
actions.description: Agent-side verb, not a UI affordance. The agent formalizes an idea as a proposal the human can then approve or defer. Never appears as a data-agent-action in the DOM; the agent commits it directly to the log.

actions.name: artifact.tap
actions.description: The child taps the artifact they made in Chapter 5 (the Workshop). Commits a human focus event on 'artifact'. Purely celebratory proof the artifact is alive — no state change.

actions.name: chapter.sound.toggle
actions.description: Flip the opt-in sound preference for the child-facing chapters. Device-local (localStorage), never committed to the log. Sound is off by default; this is the only way it turns on.

actions.name: chapter.workshop.open
actions.description: The hand-off from Chapter 5's workshop threshold into the full instrument. Commits a human focus event on 'workshop-open', then the shell switches mode. The door opens only when the child taps it — no auto-advance.

actions.name: color.pick
actions.description: The child picks a color in Chapter 4 (You have an idea). Commits a human focus event on the color node, then Lumi formalizes it as an agent proposal. The pick is the child's idea made concrete.

actions.name: color.repick
actions.description: Return from Lumi's review to the color picker in Chapter 4. A reversal, not a rejection — commits a human focus event on 'color-picker'. Fully reversible; a new pick produces a new proposal, never a duplicate for the same color.

actions.name: companion.back
actions.description: Return to the previous screen in the companion view. On the first screen, exits to the launchpad. Commits a human focus event on 'companion-back-{screen}'. Every companion screen has a visible Back.

actions.name: companion.next
actions.description: Advance to the next screen in the companion view ('Show me'). Commits a human focus event on 'companion-next-{screen}'. Never auto-advances; nothing moves without a tap.

actions.name: docs.view
actions.description: The ?mode=docs region — the live-contract surface (tokens, actions, the log fold). Informational marker, not an action an agent should invoke on its own; it exists so the region is discoverable. Hidden from any switcher; ?mode=docs only.

actions.name: companion.view
actions.description: The companion view region — the 70-year-old's window into the log. Informational marker, not an action an agent should invoke on its own; it exists so the region is discoverable.

actions.name: companion.open
actions.description: Open the companion view from the launchpad. The elder's door — a quiet secondary control below Start. Switches the shell to companion mode; commits nothing to the log. A returning visitor whose log has an artifact lands on what they made; a fresh visitor lands on a gentle empty state.

actions.name: make.confirm
actions.description: The child accepts Lumi's offer to make their idea ('Yes, make it') in Chapter 4. Commits a human approve event on Lumi's proposal. The child's own decision, so no confirmation is required.

actions.name: proposal.approve
actions.description: The child accepts Lumi's proposal in Chapter 3 ('Yes, do it'). Commits a human approve event. The proposal becomes real only on this event.

actions.name: proposal.defer
actions.description: The child declines Lumi's proposal for now ('Not yet') in Chapter 3. Commits a human reject event with reason 'not-yet'. A valid decision, not a failure — no retry, no re-prompt.

actions.name: verification.verify
actions.description: Replay the log and return the tamper-evidence verdict: valid, the seq the walk reached, the head hash, and — if the chain is broken — the seq, expected, and found hashes. A read, not a mutation. Safe for any caller with a session.

actions.name: verification.provenance
actions.description: Return the event chain from genesis to the given seq, each record carrying its prev_hash, plus the recomputed verdict and the head commitment. The artifact a reviewer asks for. A read.

actions.name: profile.love
actions.description: Read the privacy-preserving care proof for a LOVE DID: bound, careScore, verified (>= 0.5), sovereignty/performance pools, totalEarned. Returns what the ledger attests WITHOUT the care events — the LOVE privacy promise surfaced in the Loom. A read; safe for any caller with a session.

actions.name: anchor.sbt
actions.description: Witness a QPJ SBT block into the Loom's anchor store — makes the portal's client-side hash chain server-authoritative. Verifies the per-DID linkage (a rewritten block breaks it); witnesses the block's own hash as opaque (never re-derived). A write, but only to the anchor store — the log itself is untouched.

actions.name: family.view
actions.description: The family view region — one short page the whole household (and their agents) reads together: the shared artifact, the care circle, the last shared moments, provenance one tap away. Informational marker, not an action an agent should invoke on its own.

actions.name: family.open
actions.description: Open the family view from the launchpad — the whole family's door. Switches the shell to family mode; commits nothing to the log.

actions.name: family.back
actions.description: Return from the family view to the launchpad. Commits a shared focus on 'family-back'.

actions.name: family.memory
actions.description: Lumi's memory line on the launchpad — one derived sentence about what was made before ('You and Lumi have made N things together'). Folded from the log, never auto-advancing; the child still taps Start. Informational.

actions.name: family.care
actions.description: The family care circle — a status region showing the bound care record (code name, verified status, sovereignty/performance pools) or its absence. Informational; never a score.

actions.name: family.receipt
actions.description: The family receipt — the latest shared moment, with provenance and Undo. The receipt is the proof surface: 'prove what happened' links to /provenance/:seq, Undo appends a compensating event.

actions.name: family.provenance
actions.description: A link to GET /api/loom/provenance/:seq for the latest shared moment — the chain from genesis to seq, each record with its prev_hash, the recomputed verdict, and the head commitment. A read; safe for any caller with a session.

actions.name: theme.cycle
actions.description: Cycle the shell's theme in the top bar. Presentation-layer only (localStorage), never committed to the log. Purely cosmetic; safe to invoke.

actions.name: instrument.zone.trigger
actions.description: Tap a zone in the spatial music maker to hear it. EPHEMERAL — broadcast over the live presence channel, never committed to the log, never gated, never persisted. Carries data-agent-action so an agent or test can trigger it non-visually.

actions.name: instrument.zone.place
actions.description: Place a new zone in the spatial music maker. Gesture-driven in the UI (drag-and-drop / long-press-and-release); the gesture's completion callback carries the same data-agent-action semantics a button would. Commits an instrument.zone.place event through the gate — the score is replayable and provenance-tracked.

actions.name: instrument.zone.clear
actions.description: Remove a zone from the spatial music maker. Commits an instrument.zone.clear event — the removal is a log entry like any other composition change, so the arrangement stays provenance-tracked.

actions.name: instrument.zone.name
actions.description: Rename a zone in the spatial music maker. Commits an instrument.zone.name event through the gate.

actions.name: instrument.sound.toggle
actions.description: Flip the opt-in sound preference for the spatial music maker. Device-local (localStorage), never committed to the log. Sound is off by default on every device, every session; this is the only way it turns on. A shared session where one family member enabled sound does not turn sound on for another family member's device.

actions.name: instrument.listener.move
actions.description: The listener-position control — a drag surface on the spatial music scene. EPHEMERAL, not committed: moving yourself in the field is a live presence act, never a log entry. Carries data-agent-action so a test or agent can drive it non-visually.

actions.name: instrument.mapping.toggle
actions.description: Flip the vertical spatial encoding between height→pitch and height→timbre-brightness. Prototype-validated (prototype-spatial-touch.html); the decision is made empirically with a family member, not by spec.

actions.name: instrument.render.toggle
actions.description: Cycle the spatial scene's render mode: constellation (points + the listener's path trail), terrain (the audio-reactive sphere prominent), bursts (explosions at every trigger). Presentation-layer only; the composition and the audio graph are unchanged.

actions.name: control.midi.bind
actions.description: Bind a MIDI CC to a control-surface knob or fader. Commits a control.midi.learn event through the gate; the control disarms after one bind.

actions.name: control.wled.segment
actions.description: Set a WLED segment's color, effect, speed, or intensity via the WLED bridge (POST /json/state). Requires the bridge to be connected; an unreachable device reports the honest offline state, never a fake green dot.

actions.name: control.synth.param
actions.description: Set a named synth parameter (0-1 or an enum) on the active engine. EPHEMERAL — broadcast over the live presence channel, never committed to the log. Named params only; the router never touches raw engine internals.

actions.name: control.preset.load
actions.description: Load a committed patch preset into the active engine. The preset itself is a committed control.patch.set event; the load is an ephemeral broadcast that applies it to the live audio graph.
